summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing an announcement to Indian stock exchanges regarding the pricing of USD 750 million Senior Unsecured Fixed Rate Notes under its USD 7.5 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme. Moody's Ratings and S&P Global Ratings assigned Baa3 and BBB ratings, respectively, to the notes on August 18, 2026. This is a routine debt issuance disclosure, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other corporate event. No special-situation category applies; the filing is a standard current report by a foreign issuer regarding an ordinary debt securities offering.
